label: Fires at D1 after a rewarded a2->S2 trial, stronger when S2 belief is high, early episode.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_dec
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * belief_cover
explanation: Active only at D1 and essentially only when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 (common) rewarded (residual +0.34 vs about -0.14 for every other previous-trial pattern); zero at GO and D2. Within that case the magnitude grows with the observer belief that S2 is good (negative belief_lo) and shrinks across the episode (ep_dec), going silent late in episodes. The free fit adds that a rewarded trial two back raises it while a2 two back lowers it, and a small global belief_lo term; residual misses are a2 S2 r D1s where it is unexpectedly silent mid-to-late episode. Observed-only: no future or model-output variables used.

issues: The basic claims hold up. The residual is +0.338 at D1 after 'a2 S2 r' and -0.13 to -0.14 after every other previous-trial pattern. GO and D2 are exactly 0. The fitted weights point the stated way: belief_lo -0.175 (stronger when S2 belief is high) and ep_dec -0.075 (weaker later in the episode).

The verdict sits exactly on the line. The recorded short form scores test R^2 beyond timing 0.400. The indicator alone scores 0.279, adding the belief_lo term gives 0.311, and adding the ep_dec term instead gives 0.365. Every 3-term variant I tried landed between 0.34 and 0.41: thresholded belief (belief_lo<-2, <-1, <0), np.minimum(belief_lo,0), tv('reward',-2)==1, belief_cover, ep_trial (0.402), and ep_trial<78 (0.407). So 0.40 looks like the limit of this description, not a robust 'explained'.

A large systematic error class remains. The worst misses (run on the short form) are D1 steps after 'a2 S2 r' early-to-mid episode (t14-t24), all at the first one or two rewarded a2->S2 trials after the agent has just moved over from a1 or from unrewarded trials. The model predicts about 0.86-0.92 there, but the activation is 0, and it only ramps up (0.4-0.55) after several consecutive a2 S2 r trials. The feature seems to need an established run of rewarded a2, which neither belief_lo nor reward two back captures. The explanation calls these misses 'mid-to-late in the episode', which misdescribes them; most are at t14-t24.

Much of the 'goes silent late in episodes' claim is timing that is already in the baseline: the D1 baseline falls to about 0 by deciles 8-9. The ep_dec interaction adds about 0.09 of R^2 within the a2 S2 r case.
Systematic over-prediction of about -0.115 at D1 after every non-a2S2r pattern (from misses). This is a baseline/indicator offset artifact, but it shows the fit is not clean.
